title: A Newspaper Said Bat-People Lived On The Moon 🌙
caption:
A newspaper said bat-people live on the moon 🌙
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In August 1835 the New York Sun ran a series claiming astronomer John Herschel had seen bat-winged people on the moon. Sales soared. Herschel had nothing to do with it and was not amused.
Would you have bought the paper? 👇
first_comment: Fake news in 1835 had bat-people. Today's fake news has no excuse. 🌙👇
